Protein is made up of many amino acids and current labels do not provide enough information regarding the amino acids present in foods or beverages. This can make purchasing food difficult for people with PKU.
 
Requiring food and beverage companies to include the phenylalanine amount and percentage in the content of food and drink labels should make it easier for people with PKU to avoid foods that are not suitable for them.

Increase minimum wage for childcare staff. We are understaffed & overworked., The Government should increase the minimum wage for those working in childcare. We are expected to take care of the children and their families whilst teaching and observing them - and the list goes on - often for minimum wage. We put so much in for children and their families and get little back., The childcare sector is understaffed and so many nurseries are struggling to recruit. So many nurseries are losing staff due to stress and mental health. Staff put in so much work and care for very little pay.

Teach life-saving CPR in schools from Key Stage 2 onwards, Help children in Key Stage 2 identify what to do in a situation that may require CPR and how to perform it to aid in trying to save a life., Everyone should know how to perform CPR, especially if it’ll help to save a life.
Children should be taught how to perform/assist with basic CPR.

It should be taught from a young age as soon as children understand and have the physical capacity to perform it.
Too many people don’t receive CPR due to a lack of knowledge and lack of confidence never having practiced it before and that needs to change!

The best time to learn is as a child and it can be practiced and retained for a lifetime.

Lower the price of Free From Food in all supermarkets, I would like Parliament to lower the price of food that is labelled "Free From" for customers in all supermarkets. This is because all food that is "Free From" is more expensive than food that is "normal". This is unfair as customers with a intolerance do not have a choice., The food that is on the market that is free from Gluten/Milk/egg is always more expensive than normal. A normal loaf of bread without the "Free From" label on is around £1.36 whereas a loaf of bread with the "Free From" label on it £3.50 for the same loaf of bread without gluten/Wheat/eggs/nuts or Rye in it. It's not fair it being more expensive for people who have a condition that can't control what they have to eat to make them feel better and stop them getting unwell.

Give parents a right to start work late once a week to take children to school, We want the Government to make it mandatory for all work places to allow parents one later start time per week (after 9:30am), to be able to take their children to school., We believe this is paramount to promote positive parent partnerships with the school, will help promote children’s wellbeing and mental health, and reduce stress for parents around childcare and childcare costs.

Remove LGBT content from the Relationships Education curriculum, We believe that schools should not be teaching Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual and Transgender (LGBT) content to children. A lot of parents do not want this being taught and the Government should remove this from the Relationships Education curriculum so that schools are not required to teach it.,

Provide funding for free first aid training on how to deal with stab wounds, I want the Government to provide funding for free first aid training to teach people how to deal with stab wounds. Too many people are losing their lives in stabbings, and I want the Government to provide funding for first aid training that could help save lives., As a community we would rather know what to do than stand there being useless. If someone gets stabbed we want to be able to help them so they have another chance at life.

Ban lqtbq+ learning in schools and in the households, to not teach LGBTQIA's+ in schools as it's not appropriate for young minds, because it is not appropriate for children to be learning about such things as they are still young and cannot grasp the concept of these things so they will merely accept them because they aren't able to make healthy decisions for themselves

Mandate automatic General Elections when a Prime Minister is replaced mid-term., Recent events saw a Prime Minister replaced by party members, bypassing public vote. This petition urges legislation for automatic General Elections in such scenarios, ensuring the leader holds a public mandate, which is foundational to our democracy., Democracy thrives when the power to choose our leaders rests with the people. The recent replacement of a Prime Minister without a General Election raises concerns about the legitimacy and the mandate of the leader, as they were not elected by the general public but by a section of a political party. This can potentially lead to a governance crisis or public unrest due to perceived illegitimacy.

Fund a £30 Fare Cap for Train Fares, Like the £2 bus fare cap, there should be a fare cap for trains with a maximum of £30 to go anywhere, because we think train prices are ridiculously high., I think there would be more of an attraction to public transport if there was a fare cap with a maximum of £30 for any journey, like the bus fare cap.

Do not make Mathematics and English a requirement up to 18, We think Maths and English should only be compulsory up to GCSE level, and not up to 18., We believe forcing children to study Maths and English would not be a good decision. Many degrees and Post-18 choices do not require Maths or English. We are also concerned that students will struggle with the workload, which could affect their academic performance, and mental health.

Remove mandatory calorie information rules for cafes, restaurants and takeaways, The Government should change legislation introduced in April 2022, which requires calorie information to be displayed on menus and food labels in restaurants, takeaways and cafes. This should instead be replaced with optional viewing, to prevent negative impact on people with eating disorders., This was formally applied to help combat the rising obesity rates. However, we believe the policy has neglected the rising rates of eating disorders. I feel instead the law should be changed to optional menus where people can choose whether or not to have calories displayed. A survey by Beat (a UK eating disorder charity) in August 2022 found that 98% of people affected by eating disorders feel calories on menus will negatively impact them.

Put a cap on profits made by private landlords, Many people in the UK only earn the minimum wage and homelessness is increasing. I believe part of the problem with the housing market is the number of landlords who are buying properties to rent. Some of these landlords have already paid the mortgages yet are putting up the rent yearly., I want the Government to put a cap on how much profit private landlords can make on renting out properties. This will hopefully reduce the amount of landlords buying properties to rent in the first place and will make renting cheaper, giving people who are still struggling to get on the property ladder themselves a better chance to save for deposits. Many people pay nearly all their wage on rent alone, and many can't afford to rent at all, leading to homelessness.

Reduce acceptable noise levels from vehicle exhausts., We consider noisy vehicle exhausts are an anti-social blight and to people living near main roads they are a constant intrusion causing excessive stress and nuisance. We believe the current fines and legislation are outdated and insufficient and should be revisited.,

Continue student funding for students over 60 from 2025, Allow over 60s to access the £37,000 lifelong learning fund re the new student funding rules proposed from 2025.  It seems discriminatory to not allow over 60s to access education funding, especially if they have never had any student funding before., With an ever increasing focus on brain degenerative diseases such as Alzheimers, student funding should be available for the over 60s and education at any age should be encouraged.

Give main carers of children sole rights to tenancy after relationship breakdown, Set a rule for joint tenancies so that following relationship breakdown the parent who is the primary carer of the children has the sole right to occupy the property and the other tenant can be removed from the tenancy without having to go to court.,

Create a law to forbid the use of drones to deliver parcels, I would like the Government to ban the use of drones to deliver parcels due to the extra noise pollution, and privacy issues., There is already so much noise pollution in the world as it is. We are concerned about the additional impact of drones flying through the sky. People with sensory issues, PTSD, anxiety, autism, nervous pets, don't need this extra noise and sudden drones appearing. I am concerned that there will be no privacy.

All UK companies must provide a manned customer telephone helpline , We want all companies operating in the UK to be required to provide a monitored customer telephone number so that customers can get in touch and request help. , I don't think it's fair that, in some cases, you cannot contact companies you have purchased a product or service from to request help or discuss any issues. The Government should legislate so that companies have to provide adequate customer service. 

Currently some businesses do not provide a manned telephone customer support service, making it impossible to talk to someone to resolve an issue, and online services can often be inadequate.

Impose caps on annual rent rises and additional taxes on vacant properties, We urge the Government to implement rent control measures that would cap yearly rent increases for existing tenants at 2%, and also to impose additional taxes on properties that have been vacant for an extended period., Areas such as London are becoming increasingly unaffordable for many of its inhabitants. According to data the average rent in London rose 16.1% in 2022 – the highest annual jump on record. The current situation is unsustainable and unfair. An increasingly alarming number of families are finding themselves without a home as the housing situation spirals out of control. It's time we put a stop to these unreasonable rent increases that are leaving hard-working families on the brink of homelessness.

Make calling for Jihad a specific terrorist offence, Create a law to make calling for Jihad during protests a specific terrorist offence. We believe doing so incites hatred and contributes to antisemitism., It appears that the current law makes it difficult for police to arrest and prosecute people for doing this. We believe the Government needs to amend current legislation to create a specific offence for this. This is an urgent matter.
 
We believe that using this language is inspiring antisemitism and terrorism and while people are not arrested for this, we are all at risk. We must do more to protect our Jewish friends and neighbours, and also protect our communities.

Create a statutory cap on bonuses for bankers – greed is not good!, At a time when the people of the UK are facing a cost of living crisis we are shocked that the cap on bonuses for bankers is being lifted. We want legislation to be introduced to reinstate this cap., Introduced in 2014 when the UK was part of the EU, the cap was designed to curb excessive risk-taking in the financial services industry in the wake of the 2008 financial crash.

The cap limited how much extra variable pay employees of banks, building societies and investment firms could receive: the maximum was twice their basic salary.

Over the last decade banks have compensated for lower bonuses by increasing basic salaries, to make sure they could still compete with other financial

The government must act to help women with Polycystic Ovarian Syndrome (PCOS)., Official statistics show that PCOS affects 1 in 10 women WORLDWIDE. Causing life changing problems for women including fertility obesity diabetes & much more. Women are not getting the help they need in most cases dismissed by doctors, told to lose weight. The govt must act to give actionable help., Women are suffering with this condition that can absolutely be helped. Doctors very rarely know anything at all about PCOS. There is a large body of scientific research out there which has outcomes to help these women reverse this condition to live a normal life yet these studies are being ignored. This needs to change! The govt need to put in place more help for women with PCOS. This in turn will reduce the NHS bill by millions if not billions. Women need to be believed & not dismissed.

Force insurers to cap prices at 15% of the value of the vehicle, As of today (30/10/2023) there are no laws or regulations regarding the pricing of vehicle insurance, allowing insurers to get away with increasing prices by insane amounts. Government needs to force insurers to cap prices to 15% of the vehicles value. Paying £3k/year on a £1200 car is extortion., Any attempts to get an insurance quote for a newly passed 17yo driver on a cheap car, Vauxhall Corsa, Volkswagen Polo, etc, will result in quotes of £5000+, even with a black box. This is unacceptable.

Make all subjects optional at GCSE level, We don't think students should be required to take any specific subjects - such as English, maths and science - at GCSE. Students should get to choose what subjects they study., Not everyone will need the subjects that are currently compulsory for their future, so these should not be mandatory.

Require companies to report annually on age diversity, We seek for the Government to introduce legislation to mandate that companies report:
, Age Representation: Proportion of staff across all age groups
Age-Inclusive Policies: Details of practices
Progress Metrics: Quantitative goals
Corrective Actions: Specific steps taken to address age disparities

We believe we need transparent and accountable reporting to help encourage age-inclusive environments. We believe we need equal opportunities for all employees, regardless of their age, and to combat age discrimination effectively.
 
Mandatory age diversity reporting is in our view pivotal to ensure all age groups are treated equitably and provided with the same opportunities for career advancement. We believe this will help address the issue of ageism and promote diversity.

Roll out a Right to Buy scheme for all housing association tenants, I want the Government to roll out a national Right to Buy scheme for all housing association tenants, along the lines of the scheme piloted in the Midlands in 2018, so that housing association tenants can buy their property at a discounted rate., I have been living in my home for 20 years have paid more then half off the current market asking price in rent, and therefore would like to have the right to own my property which I currently live. This would make for an easier life and secure my family future.

Enhance consumer protection for holiday caravan owners, Amend the Caravan Sites and Control of Development Act 1960 to reflect changes in consumer protection regulations and require all related consumer contracts to list clearly all services and associated costs payable/deductible in respect of pitch fees. , Provide access to First-tier Tribunal (Property Chamber) to challenge any increase above CPI. 

The Government and others are aware of the issues associated with holiday caravan ownership, which have persisted for decades. We believe consumers are at significant risk of life-changing detriment as a result of unfair trading practices we consider are being operated across the sector. Challenging such practices is prohibitively expensive.

Introduce laws for AI-created content to be marked as "AI created", Introduce into law a requirement for AI-generated content to be marked or tagged as AI generated, so it is obvious to consumers of the content that what they are consuming has been created by AI, or with the help of AI., With AI becoming more popular and growing at very fast rate, it's influence is becoming more common place in the creation of content. Posts, articles, images, videos and other forms of content can now be created using AI and are often used in social media posts, advertising, and articles. It can be impossible to identify which posts, articles or pictures are created by AI, and we are concerned this can make it more difficult to tell if content may be inaccurate, incorrect and misleading. We should be able to choose if we want to consume AI generated media.

Ban schools from setting more than seven pieces of homework a week, There should a limit on how many pieces of homework a student can be set, not how many hours because it’s different for individuals on how long it takes them. We believe the current burden of homework can have a significant impact on a student's mental health., We would like there to be a maximum tasks amount that can be set. I suggest 7 a week. Students shouldn’t be spending all their free time on homework. They need to socialise, discover hobbies and have a childhood. Homework takes time for those things away from students, which can affect their opportunities for development. The constant stress from school to stay on top of work can put children off wanting to learn, which they should want to. The desire to learn is vital for children for their creativity and health.

Make climbing on, damaging or defacing war memorials a specific offence, To introduce a new law to make it a specific criminal offence to climb on, damage or spray paint a war memorial!, We have seen people climbing over war memorials during protests in London, but the police have said it’s not an offence to climb on a war memorial.

Allow schools to teach BSL instead of a modern foreign language, We want the Government to change the criteria for teaching languages to allow primary schools to teach British Sign Language instead of a modern foreign language., As the Government recognises BSL as an official language, it should have an equal place within the curriculum.
 
We believe this would be a move towards better inclusivity!
 
Currently if a school wishes to teach BSL this has to be in addition to MFL. With significant time pressure on schools, this is difficult to do.
 
Thousands of children in our mainstream schools rely on or regularly use BSL to support their education and/or communication at home.
 
This change would better allow schools teach BSL with the time and resources it deserves, and could help create an inclusive community and start children on a pathway to employment.

Offer COVID-19 boosters to all over 50s, asthmatics and long Covid sufferers, We want the Government to offer the autumn Covid-19 booster vaccinations to all over 50s, asthmatics and long Covid sufferers., We believe the COVID-19 autumn programme unfairly excludes certain people, and that widening entitlement would better protect the public and create financial savings.

Reduce the court filing fees for filing a divorce application, Reduce the fee for filing a divorce with HMCTS from £593 to £493 to reflect the decrease in work required to process a divorce following digitisation., The Government is proposing to raise court fees by an average 10% which includes fees on divorce applications from £593 to £652. The service has now been digitised. Therefore, the amount of work required to process a divorce has drastically reduced. People going through relationship breakdown should not be subsiding the rest of the court system.

Incentivise landlords not to sell properties & to charge affordable rents , Landlords are exiting the market at an alarming rate, creating a crisis for existing and prospective tenants. Rents are soaring. We believe the Government should provide financial incentives to encourage landlords to remain in the market, and to ensure rents are affordable., Rising mortgage rates and/or changes in the tax landscape are allegedly reasons for landlords exiting the market. We consider that urgent action on the part of the Government is needed in order to incentivise landlords to remain in the market, whilst making sure rents are affordable.

Create legal requirements to retrofit upper floor conversions with soundproofing, Create legislation that requires owners of converted upper floor flats to install flooring that meets current building regulations for soundproofing. Regulations have changed over the years, and many older converted properties do not have appropriate soundproofing., Current housing regulations require a basic level of soundproofing, however residents of properties that were converted before these regulations were introduced - many with thin walls and old loose floorboards - do not enjoy such protections. Excessive daily impact and airborne noise is disruptive to daily life, and can be damaging to mental health and make a home feel like a trap. For the sufferer, soundproofing a ceiling can be an eye-watering cost, hugely disruptive, and may not even work. Soundproofing at source is more effective and cost efficient.

30 hours for Nannies. Nannies are getting made redundant or laid off., Nannies are just as important as nurseries and childminders and very beneficial to some families for childcare. Why should only nurseries and childminders accept the funding when they have huge waiting lists. It’s not fair on nannies whom are getting laid off or made redundant or used temporarily., Offer nannies the 30 hours funding option. Please!  Childcare is making nannies having to change their careers due to the situation and the cost of living in the economy is effecting everyone and nannies are just as beneficial and some people are requiring them but can’t afford us. The waiting lists are so long on childminders and nurseries as they are the cheaper options but this is so unfair it’s disruptive to the children they’re care for and everyone. Please stop and change this. 🙏🏻

Introduce requirements for all stage/screen scenes with nudity/intimacy, Make it a legal requirement for production of all stage or screen intimacy or nudity scenes to have an intimacy co-ordinator present. Scenes must also be planned in writing in advance., This is for the safety of all involved. This will help prevent actors and performers being taken advantage of. Any intimacy or nudity scenes must be included in a shared printed script given to actors in advance with another crew member present. This would help remove the power imbalance faced by actors.

Cap private dentist charges, The Government should cap prices charged by private dentists. I can’t find a local NHS dentist. When I needed urgent treatment, I had to pay over £400 for a root extraction, over £100 for an appointment without treatment, and £20 for a piece of paper for the prescription. , With people struggling to find local NHS dentists, a cap needs to put on what private dentists are charging to make it more affordable.

Stop the TV licence fee., Stop the TV licence fee and force the BBC to find alternative ways to fund itself., I want the government to abolish the TV licence fee. From 01/04/24 the annual cost of a TV licence will rise to £169.50. Not taking into account inflation and future fee increases over the average persons lifetime that's roughly £10,509 . The TV Licence fee is outdated, not fit for the 21st century and an unnecessary tax on the public.

Give parents who split up automatic equal shared custody of their children, We want the law to start from the assumption of equally shared custody, with each parent being given the option to negotiate down from this, depending on work commitments etc. I don’t believe in the current system that there is any gender equality., It could help prevent missing valuable family time for children and parents. It could also help prevent upset for children, the parent with limited or no contact and their wider family too, as well as huge amounts of money parents could otherwise spend on their children. 

I think that the system is archaic and sexist; it's too easy for one parent to prevent children seeing other parents equally, or at all. I believe this is often done to punish the other parent and/or for reasons other than what is in the child's best interests.

Fund increased support for Avoidance Restrictive Food Intake Disorder (ARFID), We want the Government to provide additional funding to increase support for people with Avoidance Restrictive Food Intake Disorder (ARFID). We believe that currently many patients with ARFID struggle to access the treatment and support they need. We want the Government to help.,

Review Timetable For Phasing Out Copper Wire Landlines, The Government should work with Ofcom & the major telecom suppliers to review the timetable for the switch to digital telephone lines. We believe that doing so by 2025 is totally unrealistic if vulnerable customers are to be protected. The new internet-based system should be phased in over 5+ years., We think the industry is putting profit before safety. Vulnerable customers, often lacking digital skills, are losing access to traditional landlines despite serious concerns over the reliability of the new system, lack of emergency back-up, and potential costs for households. Some alarms and telecare systems are incompatible with the new system. Silver Voices and Digital Poverty Alliance want the two systems to work in parallel for at least five years so that vulnerable people are not forced to transfer prematurely.

Legislate against any form of Digital ID, Legislate against Digital ID to prevent digital consolidation and exploitation of our personal and private data. We believe digital ID and the consolidation of a person's private and sensitive data pose a significant threat to human and civil rights. , Digital ID or digital identification refers to a unique personal digital identifier that works like or similar to a paper-based ID (e.g., a government-issued passport or driver's license) and contains the same or similar data points. Digital consolidation of data refers to the collection of private data (e.g., biometric data, health records, social benefits, work status, references, relationship status, buying habits, social media accounts, political affiliation etc.) in a so-called digital wallet uniquely tied to an individual's Digital ID. If widely implemented or even mandated, we believe that digital ID and digital consolidation would erase the right to privacy, informational self-determination and data sovereignty which we see as pillars of working democracies.

Split Child Benefit equally between parents equally sharing care, I think that the Child Benefit payment system is outdated. We are calling for the Government to update the Child Benefit rules so that this payment is split equally between parents who share the day-to-day care of one or more children., As it stands, if there is equal day-to-day care for two or more children, each parent can receive Child Benefit in respect of at least one child. However, if there is only one qualifying child, only one parent can claim Child Benefit. Child Benefit also can't be split equally if there are an odd number of children. I think this is extremely outdated and does not reflect a common approach to parenting, where parents share the day-to-day care of a child equally.

Ban restaurants from adding a service charge to bills, The increased cost of living has seen the price of almost everything going up. Restaurants are no different, and many restaurants now also put a service charge on every bill. Many say they are a discretionary service charge, but add it automatically instead of giving the customer a choice., Most people don’t like awkward confrontations or discussions, and when you ask for a discretionary service charge to be removed, you can be confronted with hostility, awkwardness, etc. We think you should be able to add tip at the end, but not have to have a discussion to remove an extra charge.

Increase Statutory Maternity Pay to 9 months at full pay, We want the Government to increase the rate of Statutory Maternity Pay to 9 months at full pay. When on maternity leave, my rent and bills don’t change, and food costs and essentials don't change, so pay for mothers shouldn't change either., Women grow a child for 9 months to bring them safely into this world. Many mothers have financial worries when on maternity leave, and often have no choice but to go back to work early for financial reasons, and then have to deal with the cost of childcare.
 
My rent is £700 a month, which is almost as much as the current rate of Statutory Maternity Pay. We are in a cost of living crisis!

Increase Lifetime ISA property price cap for London, The current LISA scheme offers the opportunity to get a 25% bonus on deposits up to £4,000 a year, but it can only be used for properties up to £450,000, which can be hard to find in London., The Government has the power to amend this scheme to make it easier for first time buyers, by increasing the property price cap for London.
